summary: The note collects regional ghost stories and hauntings reported mainly between September and November 2023, covering Maple Hollow, Elmwood Elementary School, Walker Bridge, Whispering Meadows, Emerald Cove, Grand Merci Hospital and Old Willy's Pub. Each section pairs a legend with a named witness account. The note presents these tales as part of the region's cultural heritage and folklore.
one_line: A collection of 2023 witness accounts and legends of regional hauntings, from a weeping mill ghost to a phantom schooner and a haunted pub.
key_facts: Retired teacher Margaret Weaver reported on September 15, 2023 hearing a woman weeping near the old mill in Maple Hollow, which she attributed to the 'Lady of the Mill', a ghost said to herald misfortune.
Carpenter Richard James reported seeing a white-clad figure floating above the water near the mill on October 8, 2023 and now avoids the area at night.
Elmwood Elementary School, century-old and closed in 2019, was repurposed as a community center and is said to be haunted by early-1900s students.
Janitor Marlene O'Connor heard children's laughter and saw a young boy in outdated attire while cleaning on November 5, 2023.
Walker Bridge's tragic history dates to the late 1700's; motorists report vehicles stalling on the bridge and a shadowy figure on the roadside.
Tom Evans, interviewed September 30, 2023, said his great-grandfather told of a traveler killed in a robbery and left in the river, whose spirit is believed to haunt the bridge.
The Glenn family mansion in Whispering Meadows is over two centuries old, was declared a historical landmark in 2022, and is said to be haunted by the 'Sentinel', the phantom of Alexander Glenn.
Historian James Callaghan stayed in the Glenn mansion in October 2023, and his EVP recording of October 18, 2023 purportedly captured a gruff voice saying 'Leave this place.'
The Lady Margaret, a schooner that disappeared in 1809, is rumored to sail in the fog off Emerald Cove; fisherman Peter O'Donnell and his crew saw a translucent vessel on September 20, 2023.
Grand Merci Hospital closed in 2022 after 150 years; urban explorer Aria Fleming entered on October 31, 2023 and her grainy footage shows a possible translucent figure in the old operating theater.
Old Willy's Pub, dating to 1843, is said to be haunted by former owner 'Willy' Wilson; bartender Sarah Kincaid described seeing his shadowy figure tending the bar on September 25, 2023.
